headline: Gulf Stock Markets Rebound on Middle East De-Escalation Efforts
summary: Major Gulf stock indices climbed after senior officials from Saudi Arabia, Türkiye, and Pakistan met top Iranian leadership in Tehran to ease military tensions across the region.
why: Major Gulf equity indices serve as primary benchmarks for regional financial markets and energy-linked equities.

impacts.name: Gulf Equities
impacts.why: Diplomatic talks in Tehran reduced immediate risk premiums on regional stock markets.

why_moved: Equity markets rebounded as diplomatic talks reduced immediate fears of regional conflict escalating and disrupting trade routes.
